morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic sector shifts to propane while managing export contraction risks.
what_changed: Somany Ceramics projected overall tile exports to fall to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore.
Morbi ceramic units reduced PNG consumption due to improved propane supply availability.
Apollo Pipes targeted a Rs 1,000 crore revenue base from its ceramics business.
Somany Ceramics announced plans for a 5 MSM capacity hike via debottlenecking.
stress_signals: Overall tile exports are projected to fall to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore [202e1481c238].
improvement_signals: Improved propane availability allowed Morbi ceramic units to cut PNG consumption [81469af468f3].
what_to_watch: Monitor actual export volume trends and realization rates for Morbi tile manufacturers.
Track fuel mix economics between PNG and propane across local MSME units.
Observe execution timelines for capacity expansions and revenue target updates from major players.

surat.headline: Mixed week for Surat with diamond order improvements, crude relief, and strict printing payment terms.
what_changed: Textile markets reopened post-Diwali on Labh Panchami, and printing associations announced a 15% rate hike alongside a strict 45-day payment window.
Crude oil prices fell 17% in 10 days, providing cost relief to the local MMF textile industry.
Surat diamond units halved their Diwali break due to an increase in order inflows.
stress_signals: Position Printing Association mandated a 15% charge hike and strict 45-day credit terms, potentially stressing weaver/trader cash flows [ad48975ddfcf]
Major fire outbreak reported at a textile warehouse in Kharwasa [0925b53ab5fe]
improvement_signals: Surat diamond units shortened Diwali holidays to fulfill improved order volumes [5fc0b7b85616]
Crude oil price drop of 17% over 10 days offers input cost relief for MMF textiles [71350aa24679]
Surat Textile Policy approved 627 units involving Rs 1,521 crore in investment [021c037e28d9]
